packs.title: Toybox After Bedtime
packs.premise: Captain Button, a one-eyed plush rabbit, recruits neglected toys into a night-shift rescue crew. Their newest member, a shy wind-up star called Glim, thinks being small means being useless.
packs.arc: Repair the playroom's little routines, take the toys on make-believe expeditions, then build a nightlight parade in which Glim becomes the guide rather than the passenger.
packs.signature: Oversized everyday furniture frames tiny service stations; visible patchwork repairs, toy-scale rescue equipment, and transformations from pretend play into practical kindness.

scenes.title: One Brave Wooden Wheel
scenes.setup: Jun's toy fire engine sits beside the toybox with one ice-coated wheel and a very serious cardboard rescue badge.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the wheel's broad ice cap, then SPIN its exposed axle with liquid water at 70% pressure or more. These are separate targets; the engine moves only in the completion animation.
scenes.payoff: Jun advances exactly one wooden block and declares the station operational. Button salutes the shortest emergency response on record.

scenes.title: Stuffing, Not Steaming
scenes.setup: Button's patched sleeve has frozen stiff while his detachable badge rests at a lower repair station.
scenes.puzzle: Thaw the sleeve's ice rectangle, then WARM the badge at 25–45° and 10–35% pressure. The badge's warming target, not the melting task, enforces gentle handling.
scenes.payoff: Button can wave again. He uses the restored arm to offer Glim a place on the crew instead of another inspection.

scenes.title: The Dollhouse Tea Summit
scenes.setup: Three mismatched dolls await tea around a table too small for their extremely large diplomatic hats.
scenes.puzzle: FILL two side-by-side cups with liquid water in either order. Both unlock a central WARM teapot target at 30–50° and 10–45% pressure; the shared final pour is scripted.
scenes.payoff: The dolls replace their seating dispute with a biscuit-sharing agreement. Jun eats the cardboard biscuit and politely regrets it.

scenes.title: Glim's First Perch
scenes.setup: Glim's tiny boots are frozen above a dotted star-shaped landing assembly made from three rectangular construction zones.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE all three low landing sections, then melt the raised boot block. Glim's fall is a completion cutaway after the support tasks are finished, not live support physics.
scenes.payoff: Glim lands safely, discovers the perch fits perfectly, and asks whether rescuers are allowed to be rescued sometimes. Button nods.

scenes.title: Marble Soup Kitchen
scenes.setup: Hungry marbles queue behind a pretend soup counter; its two serving stations have different-sized ice caps.
scenes.puzzle: Clear both caps by sweeping across their widths, then FILL their exposed bowls. Finish by WARMING the chef's tasting spoon at 25–40° and 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The marbles gather around a steaming pot without becoming ingredients. The chef revises the menu's troubling punctuation.

scenes.title: A Bridge for the Longest Dog
scenes.setup: A wooden pull-along dachshund spans most of a chalk river, but its tail still needs a place to stand.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE three separated bridge footprints from near bank to far bank in any order. Their joint completion unlocks the dog's frozen departure tag; melting it triggers the crossing cutaway.
scenes.payoff: The dog crosses for an absurdly long time. Glim walks beside its tail and is promoted to rear-end navigation officer.

scenes.title: Xylophone Lunch Break
scenes.setup: A toy xylophone's four bright keys are encased in separate narrow ice targets, with a turbine music stand beside them.
scenes.puzzle: Sweep across the four fixed ice strips, using nozzle position rather than any rhythm requirement. Clearing all four unlocks a high-pressure SPIN target that starts the tune.
scenes.payoff: The xylophone plays a four-note lunch announcement. Every toy knows the words despite there being no words.

scenes.title: The Snow Globe Inside Job
scenes.setup: A miniature explorer waves from a glass-free display globe with a frozen entrance, empty pond, and dotted snowbank.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the entrance cap to unlock the pond and snowbank stations. FILL the pond with liquid water, then change to cold water to FREEZE the bank; both enable a WARM welcome lamp at 25–45° and 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The explorer leaves the globe to inspect a much larger globe: a football. Glim brings a map made from a napkin.

scenes.title: Cardboard Launch Authority
scenes.setup: A cardboard rocket has borrowed the space wizard's boots as thrusters, one at either side of its launch card.
scenes.puzzle: Melt both boot ice blocks and FREEZE two rectangular exhaust-display footprints below the rocket. All four preparations unlock the central high-pressure SPIN starter; launch motion remains a scripted reveal.
scenes.payoff: The rocket rises on a plainly visible string. The wizard insists the string is a highly advanced propulsion spell.

scenes.title: Dinosaur in the Crayon Garden
scenes.setup: A visiting preschool dinosaur has mistaken a row of crayons for flowerbeds; three toy sprouts have distinct climate badges.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE the blue sprout's pot footing, WARM the yellow sprout at 25–45°, and WARM the orange sprout at 55–75°. Both warmth goals use 10–45% pressure and can be serviced in either order.
scenes.payoff: The crayons become a colorful garden in the ending illustration. The dinosaur names every flower after Button.

scenes.title: A Sock Ghost's Sleepover
scenes.setup: A friendly guest from the sock exchange arrives with a frozen overnight bag and a tiny empty hot-water bottle.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the bag's broad ice panel, FILL the bottle target, then WARM a separate comfort patch at 30–45° and 10–35% pressure. The ghost itself is presentation, not a moving target.
scenes.payoff: The ghost curls up in a spare mitten. Jun asks if it needs the light on and gets a relieved nod.

scenes.title: Moon Cheese, Toy Size
scenes.setup: The kitchen's toy moon has frozen above a cheese-board observatory, and its astronomer is a very optimistic mouse.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE two telescope feet, melt the moon's ice shell, then WARM its exposed center at 35–55° with 10–35% pressure. The new footing is stable after completion.
scenes.payoff: The telescope points at the moon; the mouse points at the cheese. They agree this counts as interdisciplinary research.

scenes.title: The Little Red Repair Line
scenes.setup: Three toys offer separate repair stations along a diagonal shelf: a frozen helmet, an empty canteen, and a stiff comfort patch.
scenes.puzzle: MELT, FILL, and WARM the three stations with different nozzle positions and settings. Only the comfort patch requires 20–40° and 10–30% pressure; completing all stations unlocks the crew's SPIN stamp.
scenes.payoff: Glim runs the inspection queue and remembers everyone's name. Button quietly moves the captain's badge out of sight.

scenes.title: Seesaw for a Feather Captain
scenes.setup: Button and a feather-light toy admiral sit on opposite ends of a real hinged seesaw above a foam playmat.
scenes.puzzle: Grow ice ballast in two marked cups and melt it back until the BALANCE system reports a level beam. PHASE permits adjusting already-formed ballast; tilt, not a completion checklist, determines success.
scenes.payoff: The admiral finally sees over the toybox rim and spots the parade route. Button admits balance is harder than bravery.

scenes.title: The Hottest Seat in Pretend Town
scenes.setup: A plush bus has four passenger benches and two conspicuous service panels, one frosty and one overheated-looking.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the frosty panel, build a separate FREEZE cooling block, then WARM the ticket pad at 25–45° and 10–35% pressure. Cooling the pictured bus is the payoff, not a simulated temperature network.
scenes.payoff: The passengers stop hopping between seats. Glim takes the driver's helper seat and gets to ring the departure bell.

scenes.title: Biscuit Tin Mountain Rescue
scenes.setup: Jun is marooned on a stack of biscuit tins while Button lays out three low rescue-platform blueprints.
scenes.puzzle: Build two independent rescue branches: the left FREEZE platform unlocks the left MELT tag; the two right FREEZE platforms jointly unlock the right MELT tag. Complete both branches to trigger Jun's scripted descent.
scenes.payoff: Jun climbs down carrying a biscuit larger than the rescue vehicle. It is labelled essential equipment.

scenes.title: Stars Without Stage Fright
scenes.setup: Glim faces a practice audience of painted blocks; two oversized ice curtains flank a little unlit star podium.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the left and right curtain targets, then WARM the stationary podium at 30–50° and 10–40% pressure. A separate SPIN applause wheel unlocks only after Glim's station is ready.
scenes.payoff: The blocks applaud with tiny hinged hands. Glim discovers that being seen can feel different from being inspected.

scenes.title: The Rotating Biscuit Planet
scenes.setup: A toy planetarium carries three ice-coated biscuit moons around a central lamp on clearly visible mechanical arms.
scenes.puzzle: Use the MOTION system's slow orbital targets: position the nozzle above an orbit, then track the moons as they pass through the stream. Melt all three; orbit speed has a stationary assist setting.
scenes.payoff: The lamp reveals constellation-shaped biscuit crumbs. Jun insists the newly discovered Duck Nebula always existed.

scenes.title: Parade With a Spare Button
scenes.setup: The repaired toys assemble a float with an empty reservoir, frozen axle, and unfinished front-and-rear ice decorations.
scenes.puzzle: Complete two parallel preparations: MELT then SPIN the axle, and FREEZE both decoration zones then FILL the reservoir. Their joint completion unlocks a 30–50° WARM signal lamp. WARM targets use 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: Every repaired toy takes a visible job on the float. Button's missing eye becomes the emblem on the parade banner.

scenes.title: The Smallest Light Goes First
scenes.setup: The toybox doorway becomes a grand night parade route, with Glim's lamp between two frosted departure pennants.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE two route-marker bases, melt both pennants, FILL the lamp's decorative fuel cup, then WARM its separate glow target at 35–55° and 10–35% pressure. Finish with the high-pressure departure SPIN wheel.
scenes.payoff: Glim leads the whole parade across the sleeping room as its new nightlight. Button follows, finally comfortable not being first.
